changes: Added profile-aware koala init: explicit and detected codex, claude, all, and core profiles; canonical KOALA.md; profile-specific adapter asset matrix; managed re-init cleanup; and hard-coded entrypoint contract tests.
usage: Run koala init --profile=codex|claude|all|core <target>. Omit --profile for marker detection with compatibility fallback. Verify with npm run test:entrypoints and node bin/koala-codex.js verify_codex for Codex adapter contracts.
expectedOutcome: Codex projects get KOALA.md plus AGENTS.md, .Codex assets, and bin/koala-codex.js only; Claude projects get KOALA.md plus CLAUDE.md and .claude assets only; core gets no host adapter; explicit profile always wins over detection.
actualTranscript: npm run build passed. npm run test:entrypoints printed ok 1/21 through ok 21/21 and entrypoints verified. node bin/koala-codex.js verify_codex reported Codex adapter checks passed 6/7 with one advisory. koala validate --story=B-cac9 passed with 16/16 verification intent coverage.
outcomeDiff: No behavior gap found; only advisory is the known worktree-local global fallback path note from verify_codex.
limitations: none - fully covered by profile matrix, re-init cleanup, managed marker, unmarked preservation, build, entrypoint, adapter, and koala validate evidence.
pitfalls: The first implementation handled fresh init only; reviewers caught stale opposite-host assets on re-init, so cleanup and transition tests were added before DONE.
